status: Conditional observational geometry diagnostic; no metric, layout or encoding change adopted
population: 5120 centered, variance-normalized coordinate response profiles over 127997 equally weighted ordinary vocabulary entries
construction: R is the coordinate correlation matrix. D_squared(i,j)=2*(1-R_ij). G=J*R*J, J=I-11T/5120, is the double-centered Gram matrix for those profile distances.
criterion: Best positive-semidefinite rank-d approximation of G in Frobenius norm; not raw-distance stress, neighbor recall, or task loss.
limits: Raw input-coordinate profiles are not measured SNN neuron responses or biological tuning curves.
Equal vocabulary-type weighting is not corpus frequency, context, or temporal coactivity.
Centering and variance normalization are analytical choices, not accepted learning or encoding operations.
The result concerns this all-pairs distance/Gram preservation criterion only; local-neighborhood maps can have different objectives and biological geometry need not preserve these distances.
A useful geometric prior could distort these distances; this calculation neither supplies one nor proves none can help.
Signed population encoding and nonlinear conditional activation remain unspecified; negative populations are not modeled here.
No runtime arrays or additional application bookkeeping are proposed.
